decision.explanation: Both Jan P. Syse and Jean-Marie Bosch are explicitly stated in separate documents (D1S4 and D2S4) to have served as the head of government of Serralongue. These claims are directly supported by the original text and do not conflict in terms of referent identity. Since the question asks 'who was the head of government of Serralongue' without specifying a timeframe or disambiguating between them, both are valid and complementary answers.
